description: Upgrade the iOS UI color system for higher contrast and a tech-forward theme without changing layout.

userStories.title: Define semantic color system
userStories.description: As a product designer, I want a unified color system so that the UI feels consistent and high-contrast.
acceptanceCriteria: Define semantic tokens for background, surface, text, accent, and status colors
Provide light and dark variants for each semantic token (if dark mode exists)
Document token usage rules in one place
Typecheck passes
Verify in simulator using ios-debugger-agent skill

userStories.title: Apply semantic colors to base components
userStories.description: As a user, I want buttons, chips, and inputs to have clear contrast so that actions are easy to identify.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary and secondary buttons use the new semantic tokens
Text and icon colors meet the new contrast targets in normal and disabled states
Inputs and chips have visible borders or fills that distinguish states
Typecheck passes
Verify in simulator using ios-debugger-agent skill

userStories.title: Update key screens to new theme
userStories.description: As a user, I want key screens to feel cohesive and tech-forward so that the product looks modern.
acceptanceCriteria: Home, Practice, Results, Settings screens use the updated color system
Cards, sections, and separators show clear hierarchy via contrast
No layout changes are introduced
Typecheck passes
Verify in simulator using ios-debugger-agent skill
userStories.notes: Built and launched in simulator via XcodeBuildMCP; UI verification limited to login screen due to missing credentials.

userStories.title: Centralize theme access for views
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a centralized theme API so that new views can adopt the style quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme tokens are accessible from a single module or file
View-level code only uses semantic tokens, not raw colors
A short usage example is added for new screens
Typecheck passes
Verify in simulator using ios-debugger-agent skill
